DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 園路の通り方について、気になることはございますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is there anything that concerns you about using the park paths?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 犬が少し苦手です。散歩している方がいるので、犬を追い払うのではなく、私が離れて通れる道を知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 犬を追払わず自分が距離を取れる道を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'm a little uncomfortable around dogs. There are people walking their dogs, so rather than driving the dogs away, I'd like to know a route where I can keep my distance.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for a route where you can keep your distance without driving the dogs away. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらの広い道でしたら、すれ違う時に距離を取りやすいですよ。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: This wide path makes it easier to keep your distance when passing others.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: その道を通りたいです。犬がこちらへ近づいて来たら、少し待ってから進んでもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 広い道を選び犬が近づけば待ってよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'd like to use that path. If a dog comes toward me, may I wait a little before moving on?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Choose the wide path and ask whether you can wait if a dog approaches. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 道の脇で通行を妨げずにお待ちください。必要なら飼い主の方へ声をかけられますよ。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please wait at the side without obstructing the path. You can speak to the owner if necessary.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では「犬が苦手なので、少し離れて通らせてください」と伝えてみます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 飼い主へ距離を取りたいと伝える表現を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then I'll try saying, I'm uncomfortable around dogs, so please let me pass with a little distance between us.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Give an expression for telling the owner that you want to keep your distance. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ゆっくり、足元にも気を付けてお進みください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please go slowly and watch your footing too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。急に走って逃げず、道が空くまでここで待ちます。友人にも先へ急がないよう声をかけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 走って逃げず空くまで友人と待つと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I won't suddenly run away; I'll wait here until the path clears. I'll also ask my friend not to rush ahead.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will wait with your friend until the path clears, without running away. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 道が空いてから、お進みください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please move on after the path clears.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 道が空きました。友人にもゆっくり行こうと伝えて、広い道へ進みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 道が空いたことを確認し友人と広い道へ進む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: The path is clear now. I'll tell my friend to go slowly too, then take the wide path.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm that the path is clear and take the wide path with your friend. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どうぞご自身のペースでお歩きください。それでは、お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23214-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please walk at your own pace. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お荷物についてのご相談でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like advice about your luggage?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 箱に陶器が入っています。揺れると転がるので、列車で頭の上の棚へ置くのは心配です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 陶器箱が転がるため上棚使用に不安と相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: There are ceramics in this box. They roll around when it shakes, so I'm worried about putting it on the overhead rack on the train.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for advice because the box of ceramics can roll and you are worried about using the overhead rack. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 置き場所は車内の設備と混雑によります。大きさは、足元へ収まるくらいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Where you can put it depends on the train's facilities and how crowded it is. Is it small enough to fit by your feet?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 小さい箱一つです。自分の前へ置けば収まりますが、扉の近くに立つと乗り降りの邪魔になりそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 小箱は足元に収まるが扉横は邪魔と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: It's one small box. It fits if I put it in front of me, but standing near a door would probably get in the way of people getting on and off.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the small box fits by your feet but would obstruct people beside the door. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 扉の周りを避け、通路へはみ出さない場所を選んでください。乗務員へも相談できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please avoid the doors and choose somewhere it won't extend into the aisle. You can also consult the train crew.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: そうします。空席を箱のために一つ使うのではなく、自分の足元で動かない位置を確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 空席を箱で占有せず足元の非通路位置を探すと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will. Rather than using an empty seat just for the box, I'll check for a position by my feet where it won't move.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will look for a place by your feet outside the aisle, without occupying an empty seat with the box. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 移動の際は、箱の底も支えてお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: When moving, please support the bottom of the box as you carry it too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 持ち手だけで持つと箱が傾くので、底を両手で支えます。改札を通る前にチケットを出しておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 箱底を支え改札前にチケットを準備すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: The box tilts if I hold only the handle, so I'll support the bottom with both hands. I'll get my ticket out before going through the ticket gate.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will support the bottom of the box and prepare your ticket before the gate. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 箱を持って降りる際も、慌てず足元を見てください。案内は以上ですが、ほかに気になることはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: When getting off with the box, take your time and watch your footing too. That's all the guidance; is there anything else that concerns you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 置く場所と持ち方が分かったので大丈夫です。箱を抱えたまま急がず、車内の通路を空けられる所を探します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 置き場所と持ち方の案内を了承し通路を空けられる場所を探すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'm all right now that I know where to put it and how to carry it. I won't rush while holding the box, and I'll look for somewhere that lets me keep the train's aisle clear.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Acknowledge the guidance on placing and carrying the box and say that you will look for a place that keeps the aisle clear. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、割れ物にお気をつけて。よい旅を。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then please take care with your fragile items. Have a good journey.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 生活のご相談ですね。今、何にお困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like advice about daily life. What is troubling you now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 雨が降ると部屋の天井から水が落ちます。昨夜は布団を移しました。住まいの相談をしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 天井の雨漏りで布団移動した住まい問題を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: When it rains, water drips from my room's ceiling. I moved my bedding last night. I'd like advice about my housing.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Describe the housing problem of a ceiling leak that made you move your bedding. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お住まいは、ご自身の持家ですか、それとも借りているお部屋ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you own your home, or are you renting the room?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 借りている部屋です。管理会社へ連絡しましたが、修理に来る日はまだ決まっていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 借家で管理会社連絡済み修理日未定と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'm renting. I've contacted the management company, but no date has been set for them to come and repair it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you rent, have contacted management, and have no repair date yet. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その経過も担当へ伝えてください。水が落ちている場所は、説明できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please tell the adviser about that history too. Can you explain where the water is dripping?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 窓の上の天井です。その場所から水が落ちている写真も撮りました。今のところ、ほかの部屋では落ちていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 窓上天井の雨漏り写真と他室では未観察と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: From the ceiling above the window. I also took photos of water dripping from that spot. So far it hasn't dripped in the other rooms.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Describe the photos of the ceiling leak above the window and that you have not observed it in other rooms. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 相談の担当へ、確認できる内容を伺ってもらいます。今日は何を知りたいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll have the adviser ask you about the details you can confirm. What would you like to know today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 修理を待つ間、今の部屋で暮らし続けるのが心配です。住まいについて相談できる窓口へ案内してもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 修理待ち期間の生活への心配を伝え住まい相談先を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'm worried about continuing to live in the current room while waiting for repairs. Could you direct me to a place where I can get housing advice?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain your worry about living there while awaiting repairs and ask for a housing advice contact. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご希望と状況に合わせて相談先を確認します。管理会社との連絡の記録もお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll check where you can consult based on your wishes and situation. Do you also have a record of contact with the management company?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: メッセージが残っています。天井の写真と一緒に示し、連絡した日とまだ日程未定ということを伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 管理連絡記録と写真と日程未定を担当へ示すと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I still have the messages. I'll show them with the ceiling photos and explain the date I contacted them and that the schedule is still undecided.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will show the adviser the management contact records and photos and explain that no date has been set. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、担当へおつなぎします。こちらでお待ちください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I'll put you in touch with the adviser. Please wait here. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 今日は、結果の説明を受けるご予約ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have an appointment today to hear an explanation of your results, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。結果の数字だけでなく、仕事の夜勤についても先生に聞きたいです。短い時間で忘れずに話せるか不安です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 結果説明で夜勤質問を忘れないよう準備したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. Besides the result figures, I'd also like to ask the doctor about night shifts at work. I'm worried whether I can remember everything I want to say in a short time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you want to prepare so you remember to ask about night shifts when hearing your results. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 聞きたい内容を、先に整理しておきましょう。今の働き方は、どうなっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's organize what you want to ask beforehand. What is your current work pattern?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 昼と夜の勤務が交替します。夜勤は週に二回ほどで、来月も続く予定です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 交替勤務と夜勤週二回来月継続を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I alternate between day and night shifts. I work nights about twice a week, and that's scheduled to continue next month.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain your rotating shifts, night shifts about twice weekly, and that they will continue next month. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その状況を先生へお伝えします。いちばん確認したいことは、何ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll tell the doctor about that situation. What would you most like to check?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 夜勤を今の回数で続けてよいかが気になります。結果を聞いてから、勤務の相談をしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 結果説明の後に現在の夜勤回数を続けてよいか医師へ相談したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'm concerned about whether it's all right to continue the current number of night shifts. I'd like to discuss my shifts after hearing the results.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you want to consult the doctor about continuing your current frequency of night shifts after hearing the results. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 勤務の予定が分かる物も、診察でお見せいただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can also show something with your work schedule during the consultation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この予定表を見せます。会社の人へ提出する物ではなく、私の仕事の時間を先生に伝えるために持ってきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 勤務予定表を医師への状況説明用として提示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll show this schedule. It isn't something to submit to someone at the company; I brought it to explain my working hours to the doctor.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Present your work schedule to explain your situation to the doctor. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 質問は二つ三つにまとめ、分からない説明はその場で聞き返してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Summarize your questions into two or three, and ask again on the spot if you don't understand an explanation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 夜勤を続ける時に気をつけることと、会社へ伝える必要があるかを書きました。診察でこの順に先生へ聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 夜勤の注意点と会社への伝達要否を診察で順に質問する予定を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've written down what to be careful about if I continue night shifts and whether I need to tell the company. I'll ask the doctor in this order during the consultation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you plan to ask, in order during the consultation, about precautions for night shifts and whether to inform the company. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 先生へご希望を伝えます。それでは、診察のご案内までお待ちください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll tell the doctor your wishes. Please wait until you are called for your consultation. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 知らない電話が来るというご相談ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like advice about receiving unfamiliar calls, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。私の携帯番号が、知らない商品の広告へ載っています。売っていない物について何度も電話が来て困っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 自己番号が無関係商品広告へ載り反復着信に困ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. My mobile number appears in an advertisement for a product I know nothing about. I'm troubled by repeated calls about something I'm not selling.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that your number appears in an unrelated product advertisement and repeated calls are troubling you. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 広告は、どこでご覧になりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Where did you see the advertisement?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 知人がこのページを見つけて知らせました。ここにある番号は私のものですが、私はその広告を出していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 知人発見のページを示し自己番号だが自己出稿なしと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: An acquaintance found this page and told me. This number is mine, but I didn't place that advertisement.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the page found by an acquaintance and explain that the number is yours but you did not place the advertisement. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 番号と広告の内容が分かる画面を、保存されていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Have you saved a screen showing the number and the advertisement's contents?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 広告の画面と、電話の履歴が残っています。どこから確認すればよいか、見ていただきたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 広告画面と電話履歴を保存しており確認を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have the advertisement screen and the call history. I'd like you to look at them and tell me where to start checking.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you have saved the advertisement screen and call history and ask them to check. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 電話をかけてきた方へは、何とお話しになりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: What did you say to the people who called?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 二人には、私は出品者ではないと伝えました。どちらも広告を見たと言いましたが、その人たちが広告を作ったとは分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 着信者二名へ出品者でないと伝え投稿者とは断定不可と話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I told two people that I'm not the seller. Both said they saw the advertisement, but I don't know that they created it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you told two callers you are not the seller and cannot conclude they posted the advertisement. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 分かることと、まだ確認できていないことを分けて伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll ask separately about what you know and what hasn't yet been confirmed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 広告の画面と日時、電話が来た時刻を見せます。電話した人を投稿者と決めず、掲載されている私の番号について相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 掲載画面日時着信時刻を示して自己番号悪用を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll show the advertisement screen and its date and time, and the times the calls came in. I won't assume the callers posted it; I'd like advice about my number being listed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Show the listing screen, its date and time, and call times, and ask about the misuse of your number. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、記録を確認してお話を伺います。こちらへどうぞ。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I'll check the records and hear your account. This way, please. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 切手をお探しでしょうか。必要な金額は、お決まりですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for stamps? Have you decided what value you need?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 手紙へ貼る分ではなく、集めている家族へ渡す切手を買いたいです。絵柄を見て、シートのまま選べますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 家族収集用切手で貼付発送でなく絵柄シート選択を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to buy stamps to give to a family member who collects them, rather than to put on a letter. Can I look at the designs and choose a whole sheet?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you want stamps for a family member's collection, not to attach and post, and want to choose a design as a sheet. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらに、花の絵柄のシートがあります。十枚で一組です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: We have this sheet with flower designs. There are ten stamps in one set.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 花の絵柄がきれいですね。この一組を、シートのまま買いたいです。全部でいくらですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 花柄のシート一組を選び合計額を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: The flower designs are lovely. I'd like to buy this set as a sheet. How much is it altogether?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Choose one flower-design sheet and ask for the total price. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらは一枚百十円の切手が十枚で、一組千百円です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: This set has ten stamps worth 110 yen each, for a total of 1,100 yen.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 一組千百円ですね。一枚だけ切り離さず、この十枚がつながった状態でお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 一組千百円十枚を切離さず購入希望を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: One set is 1,100 yen. Please leave all ten connected, without detaching even one stamp.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm that you want to buy the set of ten for 1,100 yen without separating them. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: シートのままお渡しします。お持ち帰り用の台紙もお付けできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll give it to you as a sheet. We can also provide backing card for taking it home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 台紙をお願いします。かばんの中で折れないように、書類を入れる所へ平らに入れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 台紙を求め書類入れで平らに持運ぶと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please include the backing card. I'll put it flat in the document compartment so it won't bend in my bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask for backing card and say that you will carry it flat in the document compartment. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お支払いの後、その状態でお受け取りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: After paying, please receive it in that condition.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: シートと台紙を受け取りました。平らにしまえましたので、このまま家族へ渡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: シートと台紙を受け取り平らに収納して家族へ渡すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've received the sheet and backing card. I've put them away flat, so I'll give them to my family member like this.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you received the sheet and backing card, stored them flat, and will give them to your family member. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、お気をつけてお持ち帰りください。お買い上げありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please take care carrying them home. Thank you for your purchase.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 定期預金の満期についてのお尋ねですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have a question about your fixed-term deposit maturing, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。来月の満期後、引っ越しに使う予定です。何も言わなければ普通預金へ戻ると思っていましたが、自動で続く場合もありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 満期後引越資金使用で自動継続有無を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I plan to use it for moving after it matures next month. I thought it would return to my ordinary deposit account if I said nothing, but can it sometimes renew automatically?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether the deposit can renew automatically, explaining that you will use it for moving after maturity. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お客様の預金の継続設定を確認します。対象が分かる資料をお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll check the renewal settings on your deposit. Do you have a document identifying the deposit concerned?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この控えです。満期の翌月に使う予定なので、満期前に途中解約したいという相談ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 対象控えを示し満期後使用で途中解約ではないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Here's my copy. I plan to use the money the month after maturity, so I'm not asking to cancel it early before it matures.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the relevant document and explain that you will use it after maturity and are not asking for early cancellation. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 設定を確認して、満期時の取扱いをご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll check the settings and explain how it will be handled at maturity.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。継続する設定なら、変更を相談できる時期と方法を知りたいです。満期当日に初めて連絡するのは避けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 継続設定時の変更可能時期方法を早めに尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Thank you. If it is set to renew, I'd like to know when and how I can discuss changing that. I'd like to avoid contacting you for the first time on the maturity date.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask early about when and how to change a renewal setting. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 変更の受付条件と、手続きに必要な物も担当がご説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: The adviser will also explain the conditions for accepting a change and what you need for the procedure.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 必要な物を教えてください。設定を変更する手続きが必要なら、いつまでに済ませるかも知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 設定変更に必要な物と完了期限の説明を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please tell me what I need. If a procedure to change the setting is necessary, I'd also like to know by when I must complete it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask what is needed to change the setting and the deadline for completing it. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お使いになる時期も、担当へお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please also tell the adviser when you will use the money.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 満期は来月、使うのは翌月の引っ越し費用です、と伝えます。設定と変更の受付結果を確認し、予定を立て直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 満期翌月の使用時期を伝え設定受付結果から計画する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll say it matures next month and I'll use it for moving costs the following month. I'll check the settings and the outcome of my change request, then revise my plan.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain that you will use it the month after maturity and plan based on the settings and the outcome of the change request. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、担当へご案内します。お控えをお持ちください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I'll direct you to the adviser. Please bring your document copy. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: かごが落ちた音がしましたが、おけがはありませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: I heard a basket fall. Are you hurt?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: けがはありません。かごを落としてしまい、中の卵が割れました。商品の扱いをどうすればよいか教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 自己かご落下による卵割れを報告し商品の扱いを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'm not hurt. I dropped the basket, and the eggs inside broke. Please tell me what to do with the products.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report that eggs broke when you dropped your basket and ask how to handle the products. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 棚へは戻さず、そのかごをこちらへ置いてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Don't return them to the shelf; please put that basket here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ここへ置きました。卵のパックは閉じていますが、一つの殻が割れ、かごの底にも少し液が出ています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: かごを置き閉じたパックと底漏液を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I've put it here. The egg carton is closed, but one shell is broken, and a little liquid has leaked onto the bottom of the basket too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you put the basket down and describe the closed carton and liquid on the bottom. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらで片づけます。ほかの商品にも付いていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: We'll clean it up. Has it got onto any other products?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: パンの袋の外側へ付きました。中まで入ったかは見ていません。自分で拭いてそのまま買うか決める前に見てください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: パン外袋への付着と内部未確認を示し確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: It's on the outside of the bread bag. I haven't checked whether it got inside. Please look before I wipe it myself and decide whether to buy it as it is.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Describe the liquid on the outside of the bread bag and the unconfirmed interior, and ask them to check. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 卵とパンは、こちらで確認します。お買い物を続けるための別のかごをお渡しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll check the eggs and bread. I'll give you another basket so you can continue shopping.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。新しいかごへは、確認を終えた物だけ移してもらえますか。割れた卵を混ぜないようにしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 新かごへ確認済み商品だけ移してほしいと依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Thank you. Could you move only the items that have been checked into the new basket? I'd like to avoid mixing in the broken eggs.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask them to move only checked products into the new basket. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: そのようにいたします。商品の対応についても、確認してお伝えします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will. We'll also check and tell you how the products will be handled.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ここで待ちます。卵が割れたことと、パンの袋へ液が付いたことを担当の方にも伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 待機を了承し卵破損とパン袋付着の引継ぎを依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll wait here. Please also tell the person in charge that the eggs broke and liquid got on the bread bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Agree to wait and ask them to pass on the information about the broken eggs and liquid on the bread bag. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 状況を教えてくださってありがとうございます。それでは、確認まで少しお待ちください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for explaining the situation. Please wait a little while we check. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ベンチで読書をされていたのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: You were reading on the bench, I see.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。夕方になって、この木陰では文字が読みにくくなりました。明るい所へ移るなら、どちらがよいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 夕方木陰の読書で文字が見づらく明るい場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. Now that it's evening, the words are getting hard to read in this tree's shade. Where would be good to move for more light?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that the words are hard to see while reading in the tree's shade in the evening and ask for a brighter place. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今は広場側にまだ日が当たっています。ただ、暗くなるまで長くはありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: The plaza side is still in the sun now. But it won't be long until it gets dark.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 広場のベンチで、章の終わりまで読んで帰ります。暗くなる前に切り上げたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 広場で章末まで読んで暗くなる前に帰ると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'll read to the end of the chapter on a bench in the plaza, then go home. I'd like to finish before dark.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you will read to the chapter's end in the plaza and go home before dark. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 帰る際は、通路を使って入口へ戻ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: When leaving, please use the path to return to the entrance.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 帰り道も確認したいです。来た時は木の間を近道しましたが、暗くなってからは通路を使います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 暗くなる前の帰路を聞き木間近道を避けると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'd like to check the way back too. I took a shortcut between the trees when I came, but after it gets dark I'll use the path.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask about your route home before dark and say that you will avoid the shortcut between the trees. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 広場から右の通路を進むと、中央の入口へ戻れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: If you follow the path to the right from the plaza, you can return to the central entrance.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 右の通路から中央入口ですね。今はしおりを挟んで本を閉じてから、ベンチへ移ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 右通路中央入口を確認ししおりを挟んで閉じてから移動と話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: The right-hand path to the central entrance, correct? For now, I'll put in my bookmark and close the book before moving to the bench.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm the right-hand path and central entrance, and say that you will put in a bookmark and close the book before moving. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 足元を見ながら移動してくださいね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please watch your footing as you move.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。歩きながら続きを読まず、座って読みます。章が終わったら、まだ明るいうちに右の通路で帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 歩行読書せず着席読了後明るいうちに帰ると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I won't keep reading while walking; I'll sit down to read. When I finish the chapter, I'll take the right-hand path home while it's still light.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you won't read while walking and will go home while it is light after finishing the chapter seated. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、短い読書の時間をお楽しみください。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23216-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then enjoy your short reading time. Take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23217-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23217-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご旅行の記念に、駅の写真を撮りたいというご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23217-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like advice about taking a station photo as a memento of your trip?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23217-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23217-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。初めて来たので、駅名の看板と一緒に写りたいです。改札の前で立ち止まると人の邪魔になりそうですが、どこなら撮れますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23217-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 駅名看板と撮りたいが改札前の通行を妨げず撮れる場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23217-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. It's my first visit, so I'd like a photo of myself with the station-name sign. Stopping in front of the ticket gates would probably obstruct people; where can I take it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23217-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask where you can take a photo with the station-name sign without blocking traffic in front of the ticket gates. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23217-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23217-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この駅では、外の広場の印がある所からお撮りいただけます。改札の中へ入る必要はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23217-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: At this station, you can take photos from the marked spot in the plaza outside. You don't need to go inside the ticket gates.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23217-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23217-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 外の広場ですね。切符を買ってホームへ行くのではなく、外の看板を背景に撮りたいです。友人にもその場所を伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23217-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 改札内ではなく外の広場の看板で撮る希望を確認し友人へ伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23217-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: The plaza outside, correct? Rather than buying a ticket and going to the platform, I want a photo with the outside sign in the background. I'll tell my friend the location too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23217-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm that you want the sign in the outside plaza rather than inside the gates, and tell your friend. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23217-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23217-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 看板の下を通る方がいらっしゃいますので、通行が途切れてからお撮りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23217-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: People pass beneath the sign, so please wait until there is a break in foot traffic before taking the photo.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23217-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23217-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ほかの人の顔を入れたくないので、通る人がいなくなるまで待ちます。私は印の上で、友人はどの辺りに立てばよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23217-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 通行人が途切れるのを待ち撮影する友人の立つ位置を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23217-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I don't want to include other people's faces, so I'll wait until no one is passing. I'll stand on the mark; whereabouts should my friend stand?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23217-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will wait for a break in foot traffic and ask where your friend taking the photo should stand. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23217-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23217-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 撮る方も広場側にお立ちください。この線より通路側へは出ないようお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23217-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: The photographer should stand on the plaza side too. Please don't go beyond this line toward the walkway.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23217-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23217-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 二人とも広場側に立ちます。携帯の画面を見て後ろへ下がり続けず、先に位置を決めておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23217-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 二人とも広場側で立ち位置を先に決めると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23217-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: We'll both stand on the plaza side. Rather than continuing to step backward while looking at the phone screen, we'll decide our positions first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23217-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will both stand on the plaza side and decide your positions first. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23217-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23217-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 撮影が済んだら、次に撮りたい方にも場所をお譲りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23217-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Once you've finished, please give others who want to take photos a turn too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23217-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23217-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 一枚撮れたら友人と交代して、それぞれ一枚ずつにします。看板が読めるかその場で確かめて、終わったら場所を空けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23217-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 交代して一枚ずつ撮り看板の文字を確認後に場所を空けると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23217-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: After one photo, I'll switch with my friend so we get one each. We'll check there that the sign is readable, then clear the spot when we're done.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23217-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will take turns for one photo each, check the sign's lettering, and then clear the spot. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23217-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23217-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、通行の様子にもお気をつけて。よい思い出になりますように。いってらっしゃいませ。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23217-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then please also watch the foot traffic. I hope it becomes a lovely memory. Enjoy your visit.
